bear.reason: value-trap leg: GLP-1 + Atkins decline prove secular; revenue continues past consensus; margin ~ worst clean year (FY2020 9.58%); multiple at the trough band (ex-current low 6.11).

base.reason: margin = 7yr clean median 15.51% (clean stats bracket the anchor; no realized break — FY2025 resolved: $60.9M intangible impairment, 10-K 0001702744-25-000046; ex-impairment margin 15.0%, at the median; residual ~$22.8M of the CIQ gap is definitional — intangible amortization 16.9 + transaction costs 0.8 — not operating). Revenue = consensus FY26E 1334 [amended 2026-07-21 pre-verdict: FY26 guidance reinstated at the fiscal Q3 print (2026-07-09, 8-K 0001702744-26-000021) at $1.345–1.355B; base revenue 1,330 sits below the guide midpoint — the base leg is conservative vs management's own path.]. Multiple below the 17.9x own-history median (35 closes, 8.55y): the category question (GLP-1/Atkins) earns a durable discount; 12.5x = 14th percentile of the corrected band.

bull.reason: overshoot resolves: Quest carries growth, Atkins stabilizes at a smaller base; margin between median and best (17.35%); multiple toward but below the 17.85x own-history median (16.0x ≈ 29th pctile of the corrected 8.55y band) [amended 2026-07-21 pre-verdict: band refresh #162].

revenue.method: DRAFT — ratify at review. Legs are set off the consensus path and the LTM base rather than round numbers: base IS consensus FY26E (the company issued no numeric guidance), bull sits just under LTM on a stabilizing Atkins, and bear takes revenue materially past consensus to price the secular GLP-1/Atkins-decline case.

margin.method: DRAFT — ratify at review. Operating-margin legs are set off the CLEAN reported history with FY2025 adjusted for the quantified $60.9M Atkins-brand + licensing-agreement intangible impairment — the clean stats BRACKET the naive anchor rather than breaking from it. Bear sits at the worst clean year, base at the 7yr clean median, bull between median and the FY2022 best.

gate_adjudication: ~80% one-off bar fired at 72.8%; residual identified as vendor-definitional, not operating; analyst adjudicated RESUME 2026-07-21.

verdict.rationale: BUY at 10.92. Underwrite PASS 4.03:1 at 10.92 (2026-07-20); re-verified 4.03:1 at entry (same close — entry recorded 2026-07-21 against the 2026-07-20 session). Freshness (fiscal Q3 print 2026-07-09, 8-K 0001702744-26-000021): FY26 guidance reinstated at $1.345-1.355B — base revenue 1,330 sits below the guide midpoint, so the base leg is conservative vs management's own path; guided adj-EBITDA margin ~16.5% (222.5/1,350 midpoints) vs our normalized ~17.1% EBITDA-margin equivalent. Atkins -24.6% (brand impaired FY25 — management corroborates the bear direction the grid already prices); Quest +1.1% — the carry engine is unproven, the accepted open risk; OWYN +3.6%. GM guided ~-375bps; YTD FY26 non-cash impairments $331.0M. Side taken: overshoot over category decline — the market sold a consensus beat with reinstated guidance down to ~5.65x (0th percentile of the 8.55y band, below the 6.11x band low), the overshoot signature; trailing FCF yield ~12.3% (CIQ levered FCF 125.5 / entry mcap 1,023); buybacks active (~2.1M sh / ~$25M in the quarter); net debt ~1.5x guided adj-EBITDA (lease-inclusive 324.6/222.5; the 8-K's loan-basis reads 1.2x), self-funding. Known fragility, accepted: fails 2:1 only if revenue ~-26% AND margin below the worst clean year (9.58%) AND multiple below the band low coincide — boundary verified at entry: 1,100 × 8% × 6.0x → $3.54 → 2.17:1 clears; 1,050 × 7% × 6.0x → $2.62 → 1.92:1 fails. Quest stall is a bull-leg risk; bull is never in the ratio.
reunderwrite_triggers: Quest revenue growth ≤ 0% YoY for two consecutive quarters → carry engine dead; re-underwrite bull and base legs
FY26 guidance cut at the fiscal Q4 print (~Oct 2026), or initial FY27 guidance below ~$1.30B → base revenue path fails
gross-margin erosion beyond the guided ~375bps, or sustained GM below ~31% → margin regime break
